description:
It was somewhere  
Love is something you can see at a glance.  
If so, this is also... After all, it was love. Jiwon fell in love at first sight with Yoomin,


the master of 'Midnight Combo', a cocktail bar he accidentally visited ! After that, I go to the 'Midnight Combo' every day... Jiwon and his best friend Haechan. Yoo-min and his best friend Woo-chan. Even Jung Hoon, a super-beautiful man whose insides are unknown.... A delightful cocktail bar with no quiet days, a midnight combo!
